title: Algerian Lamb Tagine with Smoky Flavor
description: A Chinese-inspired twist on the traditional Algerian lamb tagine, with a smoky flavor from the lovely smoky spice blend.

ingredients.name: tagine
ingredients.notes: traditional clay pot or substitute with Dutch oven

instructions: Heat the oil in the tagine or Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the lamb pieces on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside.
Add the onion, garlic, and ginger to the pot and cook until the onion is softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the lovely smoky spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth, dried apricots, and browned lamb back to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Bake at 300°F for 2-1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Stir in the chopped almonds and serve hot.
